terbaru.judul: How to reconstruct (anonymously) a secret cellular automaton
terbaru.pelajaran: We consider threshold secret sharing schemes based on cellular automata (CA) that allows for anonymous reconstruction, meaning that the secret can be recovered only as a function of the shares, without knowing the participants' identities.

terbaru.judul: On a Constraint on Invariant Measures of Certain Cellular Automata (Bi-Permutative and More)

terbaru.judul: Coarsening and Bifurcations in Wide-Range Two-Dimensional Totalistic Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: We investigate Boolean, totalistic cellular automata with a majority or frustrated majority vote rule, and an interaction range of variable span.

terbaru.judul: General control of linear cellular automata

terbaru.judul: Control of Cellular Automata by Moving Agents with Reinforcement Learning

terbaru.judul: Breaking the Entanglement-Structure Trade-off: Many-Body Localization Protects Emergent Holographic Geometry in Random Tensor Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a systematic numerical investigation of the "entanglement geometry gravity" chain in random tensor networks (RTN) established by the ER EPR conjecture and Jacobson's thermodynamic derivation.

terbaru.judul: Extended Hybrid Timed Petri Nets with Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection for Switched Systems, Modelling and Fault Detection
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a unified fault detection framework for hybrid dynamical systems by integrating an Extended Timed Continuous Petri Net (ETCPN) model with semi-supervised anomaly detection.

terbaru.judul: BraiNCA: brain-inspired neural cellular automata and applications to morphogenesis and motor control
